subject: software_engineering
title: Software Engineering Lab
note: Sample questions written for VivaBridge. No real exam data.

concepts.unit_test: A test that checks one small unit of code in isolation
concepts.integration_test: A test that checks that multiple components work together
concepts.waterfall: Sequential phases; each finishes before the next starts; late changes are costly
concepts.agile: Short iterative cycles that deliver working software and gather feedback each sprint

questions.text: What is the difference between unit testing and integration testing?
questions.rubric_notes: Unit = one function or class in isolation (often with mocks); integration = components together (e.g. API + database). Unit tests are faster and run more often.

questions.text: Why might all unit tests pass but the application still fail?
questions.rubric_notes: Units are tested in isolation with mocks, so bugs in interfaces, configuration or data contracts only appear when components are combined. Integration tests catch these.

questions.text: Compare the Waterfall and Agile development models.
questions.rubric_notes: Waterfall: linear phases, fixed requirements, late testing. Agile: iterations or sprints, changing requirements welcome, continuous feedback.

questions.text: For a university app whose requirements keep changing, would you choose Waterfall or Agile? Why?
questions.rubric_notes: Agile, because iterations absorb changing requirements and bring early user feedback; in Waterfall late changes are expensive.
